items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: Well after I left Jack, me and my brother in law made up a band called it. We had me on sax and clarinet and my brother in law on trumpet.

ctx.x: We were talking about the dance bands, you say you played with Jack Carey, I suppose it would be around the middle 20's you were talking about with Jack Carey. Where did you go from there after you left Jack?

Well after I left Jack, me and my brother in law made up a band called it. We had me on sax and clarinet and my brother in law on trumpet. And we had Joe Avery on trombone. And Sammy Penns on drums. We used my cousin a couple of times on banjo. We had Sammy Penns on banjo. Baptiste? Yeah we used Baptiste on banjo.
What was your brother in law's name the trumpet player again?
